title: Staging MariaDB compatibility for the migration 1041 runtime audit note

phases.objective: Make ordered Staging schema replay compatible with MariaDB 11.4 when migration 1041 records its complete audit-only runtime gate note after hard-disabling the temporary Hostinger executor gate.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging schema bundle generator and disposable MariaDB 11.4
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact Staging checkout applies the ordered baseline and migrations through migration 1041 in a disposable local MariaDB 11.4 schema.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: platform_runtime_config accepts the complete audit-only note after its note column is widened before the writer, the builder regression and ordered pre-use plan pass, and no provider or Production operation is performed.
steps: Load the canonical baseline and ordered migration chain in the isolated schema-bundle builder.
Widen platform_runtime_config.note from the baseline VARCHAR(255) contract to TEXT immediately before migration 1041 writes its complete audit note.
Apply migration 1041, run the builder regression and plan-only audit, then require confirmed disposable replay before producing role bundles.
Keep Production mutation, provider mutation, deployment, credential payload reads, and data export forbidden.
assertions: Migration 1041 widens platform_runtime_config.note before its UPDATE writer.
The complete audit note is preserved without truncation and the runtime gate remains disabled.
The Staging builder regression and ordered pre-use plan remain successful before confirmed replay.
Production mutation remains explicitly forbidden and provider access remains forbidden.
